$comment: Production fixes that a releasable commit MUST contain. Checked by
deploy/verify-production-fixes.mjs in the release workflow before the build,
and again before the artifact is uploaded. A failure here is the gate that
stops a release from shipping production code that lacks the reviewed fixes.
`mustNotMatch` / `mustMatch` are regular expressions applied to the file.
When the reviewed production patch is committed, update this file in the
same commit so the policy describes the exact fix that is now in the tree.

fixes.title: Trust the production Postgres CA instead of disabling certificate verification
fixes.reason: The live runtime requires the reviewed CA patch in src/db/pool.ts. A commit without it either fails to connect or silently accepts any certificate, so it must never become a release.

fixes.title: A committed lockfile for the app and the realtime server
fixes.reason: Releases are installed with `npm ci`, which refuses to run without a lockfile that matches package.json. The production checkout carries an uncommitted lockfile repair; a release must be built from a commit that contains it.
